summary: Requested the last missing measurement for the event-backpressure finding: the same park and cluster stall at the shipped default event capacity. The harness revision adds one case (`default_capacity_event_bound_stops_actor_loop`) and leaves the three already-executed cases untouched; it drains events only on node 1, keeps `RuntimeConfig::default()` unchanged (event_capacity 1024), paces writes at one per millisecond so consecutive decided-index changes are observed in separate ticks, waits up to 90s for both unread nodes to stop answering commands, and requires: both parked, node 1 still responsive, its decided index unchanged across the attempt, and at least 1024 transitions observed before the two nodes parked (so the bound really is the default). This addresses the current limitation 'bounds witnessed are 64 and 8, not the 1024 default, argued from source'. Submission validated with execution requested; locally the new case was still running when the turn ended, so its receipt is what will settle it. Nothing else changed: the three supported findings (event-channel park and its cluster-level stall, the core's missing accept-phase repair for a lost Accepted, and append_notify resolving Ok for an index occupied by another entry) keep their recorded accounts, receipts and limits.
